description: Free. Returns TVR's valuation category for a cryptocurrency (Undervalued, Fair Value or Overvalued) and the rule behind it. Label only: the exact TVR Estimated Value and Fair Value Gap, with the main reasons, come from get_fair_value_verdict ($0.02). Accepts a ticker or a name. Data from True Value Rankings (truevaluerankings.com).

coin.description: Cryptocurrency ticker or name (e.g., BTC, Bitcoin, ETH, LTC, XMR, SOL, ADA, AVAX, DOT, POL, LINK)

name: get_tvr_estimated_value

as_of.description: When the prices behind this answer were taken (prices_as_of) and the day the coin's eight metric scores last changed (scores_last_changed)

context.description: Standing context about TVR and how to read its outputs

error.description: false on a normal answer, or an error message

fair_value_gap.description: Gap between TVR Estimated Value and market price, formatted as a percentage

paid_option.description: Where relevant: the paid TVR capability that goes further than this free answer, with its price, how to pay, the licence and an example call. Nothing is charged unless the client pays.

paid_verdict.description: The paid fair value verdict for a coin: the exact Fair Value Gap and TVR Estimated Value with the main reasons and caveats, its price and how to call it. Nothing is charged unless the client pays.

requested.description: What was asked for, when it could not be resolved

status.description: Present when the request could not be answered as asked, for example not_available

trimmed.description: Present when this free answer leaves out the exact figures and written reasons, with where to find them

tvr_estimated_value.description: TVR Estimated Value, formatted in USD

valuation_rule.description: The published valuation rule: Undervalued at least 4% above the market price, Overvalued more than 15% below it, Fair Value between

title: Get TVR Estimated Value
